say:1:1430234401:1.text: Yes, Prince Ravion likes commoners more. How do we get closer to him...?
say:1:1430234401:1.source_cn: 对啊，之前沙利叶殿下就更亲近平民，我们该怎么去亲近他？
say:1:1430234401:1.male: Yes, Prince Ravion likes commoners more. How do we get closer to him...?
say:1:1430234401:1.female: Yes, Prince Ravion likes commoners more. How do we get closer to him...?

say:3:1430234402:1.text: Well, of course, we can't reach out to Prince Ravion directly! We can start by making a gesture of goodwill to Indris...
say:3:1430234402:1.source_cn: 当然不是直接去接触沙利叶殿下！我们可以先向因度厄示好……

say:4:1430234403:1.text: However, there is still a problem. Indris doesn't seem to care about nobles or our overtures.
say:4:1430234403:1.source_cn: 不过现在依然存在一个问题，因度厄对于我们贵族的示好，好...
